summary: Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (auth/members/transactions/investments [onetime+recurring+dynamic]/loans/dashboard/CSV). Frontend mobile UI: login -> dashboard -> Money/Invest/Loans/More tabs render; transaction & investment forms open; full investment E2E (create recurring SIP -> list -> detail) works; dark-mode toggle persists via localStorage 'theme_mode'. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). One seed-data gap: demo@family.app was NOT pre-registered despite memory file saying 'already registered' — had to register via API before UI tests could pass. No critical issues blocking the build.

issues: RN <Switch> renders as a <div> on web with no role='switch' / aria-checked. Real touch works on mobile; only impacts accessibility & e2e testing on web — Playwright mouse.click does NOT fire onValueChange (must use keyboard Space or tap). Non-blocking.

action_items: Seed the demo@family.app / demo1234 account on backend startup (or document it as 'must be registered first'). The memory file /app/memory/test_credentials.md claims it is already registered but the database had no such user — testing agent had to POST /api/auth/register before login could succeed.

(Optional) Wrap the RN Switch with accessibilityRole='switch' + accessibilityState={{checked: mode==='dark'}} so it exposes role/aria-checked on web (improves accessibility and Playwright reliability).
(Optional) Address React Native Web warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — most likely originating from a third-party component.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: calc_recurring_invested uses (ed.month - sd.month) + 1 which gives an inclusive month count — matches the test expectation but is slightly off for partial months; consider day-aware calculation for edge cases (start on 31st, etc.).
Transaction list endpoint date filter compares ISO strings via $gte/$lte — works only because dates are stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings; relies on consistent client format.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection on all GET endpoints (no ObjectId leakage). UUID4 strings used for all primary keys. Good.
AuthContext / API client use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — correct env-var driven configuration; no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements (FABs, tabs, switches, list rows, form fields, save buttons) have testID — excellent test instrumentability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (login, navigation, tx form, investment full E2E create+list+detail, loans tab, dark-mode toggle & persistence)

seed_data_creation: Registered demo@family.app / demo1234 via POST /api/auth/register so UI login tests could proceed. Also auth_session fixture in conftest.py creates a fresh TEST_<uuid>@family.app user per test session to avoid cross-test contamination.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_family_finance.py (20 tests, ~4s, all green). Run via: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v. demo@family.app is now registered. UI selectors use testIDs documented inline in app screens. Note: the RN <Switch> on web is a <div>; to toggle it in Playwright, focus + page.keyboard.press('Space') instead of click.
rca_of_issue: The only deviation from the spec was that the documented demo account was not actually present in the DB at the start of this iteration — this is environment seed drift, not a code bug. Fixed by registering once via API.
